generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.
Rates quoted should be exclusive of GST.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a manufacturer and shall have designed, manufactured, supplied, installed and commissioned microprocessor controller based Gravimetric Coal Feeders for 210MW or higher capacity of Units in the past 10 years. The feeders shall be in satisfactory operation for at least one year as on date of one month prior to bid submission date. In support of this, the bidder shall furnish copies of Purchase Orders/ Work Orders not more than five of similar work of value not less than 8 Crore for having supplied to any leading power generating companies like NTPC, State Gencos or any major private Gencos.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of Purchase Orders/ Work Orders/ Work Completion Certificates relevant to Technical criteria.

technicalCriterionList.description: a)The annual turnover of the bidder shall not be less than Rs.28.68 Crore (Rupees Twenty-Eight Crore Sixty-Eight Lakh only) in at least Two (2) of the preceding five (5) financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). As a proof, the bidder shall furnish a copy of Annual financial statements or reports duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. b)The Net Worth of the Bidder as on the last day of the preceding financial year (ending on 31-03-2026) should be positive.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual financial statements or reports duly certified by the CA in at least Two of the preceding five financial years.
